extraction_notes: The p. 1 function diagram identifies BAT54S marking KL4 as two series-connected Schottky diodes with pin 3 at the midpoint; the supplied PDF covers the BAT54, BAT54A, BAT54C, and BAT54S family, so the electrical table and characteristic curves are family-level unless a BAT54S-specific distinction is stated.

Fig. 1 provides usable typical forward-characteristic curves at Ta=25 degC and Ta=100 degC. The three points on each curve are direct observations at the plotted 200 mV, 400 mV, and 600 mV vertical grid lines; values are approximate readings from the supplied graph and no intermediate points were synthesized.

Fig. 2 provides usable typical reverse-characteristic curves at Ta=25 degC and Ta=100 degC. The seven points on each curve are direct observations at the plotted 0 V, 5 V, 10 V, 15 V, 20 V, 25 V, and 30 V vertical grid lines; reverse current is represented as a positive magnitude on the plotted microampere axis and no intermediate points were synthesized.

Fig. 3 provides a usable typical junction-capacitance curve at Ta=25 degC and f=1 MHz. The seven points are direct observations at the plotted 0 V, 5 V, 10 V, 15 V, 20 V, 25 V, and 30 V vertical grid lines; no intermediate points were synthesized. The graph reads approximately 11.7 pF at 1 V, while the table gives maximum CT=10 pF at VR=1.0 V; both published values are retained without reconciliation.

Fig. 4 provides a usable typical power-derating curve. The six points are direct observations at the plotted 0 degC, 25 degC, 50 degC, 75 degC, 100 degC, and 125 degC grid lines; no intermediate points were synthesized.

The electrical-characteristics table gives maximum VF values of 240 mV at IF=0.1 mA, 320 mV at IF=1.0 mA, 400 mV at IF=10 mA, 500 mV at IF=30 mA, and 1000 mV at IF=100 mA, all at Ta=25 degC. It gives maximum IR=2.0 microampere at VR=25 V, maximum CT=10 pF at VR=1.0 V and f=1 MHz, and maximum trr=5.0 ns at IF=IR=10 mA, Irr=0.1 x IR, RL=100 ohm.

Absolute maximum bounds at Ta=25 degC are VRRM=30 V, VRMS=21 V, VDC=30 V, IF(AV)=0.2 A, IFSM=0.6 A at t=8.3 ms half-sine, and PD=0.2 W. The datasheet also specifies Tj=125 degC, TSTG=-55 to +150 degC, and typical RthetaJA=500 degC/W on p. 1; these are ratings or thermal data, not fitted DC points.

The supplied datasheet publishes no breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current specification; VRRM and VDC are rating limits only. Reverse recovery is tabulated and retained as direct datasheet evidence; no fitted or derived transient parameter is included in this extraction.
